variables.name: GOTRUE_API_HOST
variables.description: Bind address for the GoTrue (Supabase Auth) API server. 0.0.0.0 binds all interfaces so Railway's proxy can reach it.

variables.name: GOTRUE_API_PORT
variables.description: Listen port for GoTrue API. Set to Railway-injected ${{PORT}} so health checks and Kong proxy can reach it.

variables.name: GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for GoTrue. Uses private networking and references postgres service vars. The *** is auto-resolved by Railway to the actual password.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Raw PostgreSQL connection string (without search_path). Available for migrations and tooling.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HS256 secret used to sign and verify all Supabase JWTs. Auto-generated 64-char secret. Referenced by rest, realtime, storage, and kong via ${{auth.JWT_SECRET}}.

variables.name: GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET
variables.description: GoTrue-specific JWT secret. Mirrors JWT_SECRET within the same service.

variables.name: GOTRUE_JWT_EXP
variables.description: JWT expiration time in seconds (3600 = 1 hour).

variables.name: API_EXTERNAL_URL
variables.description: External-facing API URL. Points to the Kong gateway's public domain so OAuth redirects work correctly.

variables.name: GOTRUE_SITE_URL
variables.description: Site URL for auth redirect flows. Points to the Kong gateway public domain.

variables.name: GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST
variables.description: Comma-separated list of additional allowed redirect URIs for OAuth flows. Leave empty to allow only the site URL.

variables.name: GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable external email provider support. Set to false to disable email auth.

variables.name: GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM
variables.description: Auto-confirm user emails on signup (development mode). Set to false in production to require email verification.

variables.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP server host for sending auth emails. Leave empty to disable email sending (emails will not be sent). Example: smtp.gmail.com

variables.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT
variables.description: SMTP server port. Common: 587 (TLS), 465 (SSL), 25 (unencrypted). Leave empty if GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST is empty.

variables.name: ANON_KEY
variables.description: Public client API key — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=anon. Used in client-side API calls. Generate at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys using your JWT_SECRET.

variables.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Server-side key with full database access — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=service_role. Keep secret. Generate at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys using your JWT_SECRET.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for admin dashboard access (if Studio were included).

variables.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for admin dashboard access. Auto-generated.
